paper_title: Practical: Retargeting AI Kernel DSLs Beyond GPUs: An Experience Report on Refactoring TileLang to Sophgo TPUs

fig4.claim: Standalone operators have average speedups from 1.05x to 1.23x over PPL.

fig5.claim: Optimized FlashAttention averages 12.50x speedup and MLP W8A16 averages about 1.01x over PPL.

fig6.claim: Structured pipeline lowering and bank-aware LMEM placement both contribute positive speedup on representative FlashAttention and Matmul cases.

known_boundaries: FlashAttention fp32 is excluded from valid TL/PPL performance comparison.
Matmul fp32 follows BM1690 GEMM input semantics: fp32 input/output, fp16 GEMM operands, fp32 accumulation.
Cmodel validates correctness and does not reproduce PCIe performance.
